ns2:section.sectionText: This is an applied finance and economics course that focuses on the structure and operation of the multi-trillion dollar mortgage and asset-backed securities markets. The course begins with an overview of the fundamentals of bond and mortgage contracts and a review of basic analysis tools such as duration and convexity. The course then considers the fundamentals of residential and commercial real estate contracting and analyzes methods to design mortgages to manage risk. The second part of the course focuses on the residential and commercial mortgage-backed security markets. We will discuss the fundamentals of securitization, and strategies to structure deals. We will also consider collateralized debt obligations (CDOs), credit default swaps (CDS), and real estate investment trusts (REITs).
